title: Unicon grading plan
description: What the compiler in the forge repo writes at every valid save of a task, as plans/<stage>.json in the task repo, in the commit its publication points at. Flat and fully resolved: every foreach is expanded over the task's actual tests, and folded into one batch step where the primitive takes a batch. Every step carries its primitive image by digest, its entrypoint and its limits; the plan names the harness image by digest; nothing is left to resolve at grade time, because the harness may not talk to the forge. The harness runs the steps in order, one sandboxed container each, and never reads workflow YAML or a primitive's declaration.

schema_version.description: The plan shape this file is written against. The harness refuses a version it does not speak, because a compiler that emits a shape the harness reads differently produces a wrong verdict rather than an error.

harness_image.description: The harness image this plan was compiled for, as a full reference by content digest and never by tag, so a task keeps grading on the image it was published with. The forge repo tells the CI to run exactly this image.

stage.description: The grading stage this plan belongs to. A task compiles one plan per stage.

tests.description: The test list, in order: the stems of the files of the foreach list, sorted with numbers compared as numbers. Every per-test step and every batch item names one of these. Empty when no step runs per test.

steps.description: Run in order, one container each. A step sees another step's outputs only through the references in its inputs.

verdict.description: The workflow's outputs block compiled: which step outputs fill the verdict. A reference to a per-test step is read per test.

outcome.description: The run's outcome. For a per-test step: accepted when every test is, otherwise the first non-accepted test's outcome in test order.

metrics.description: Named numbers over the run. A per-test reference is summed over the tests and also fills each test row's metrics; a run-once reference is taken as it is.

tests.description: Where each test row's time and memory come from. 0 when not given or when the test was skipped.

summary.description: The contestant's summary, when that output is non-empty text; otherwise the harness writes one sentence.

image.description: A container image by content digest: a registry path, which may carry a port, followed by @sha256: and 64 hex characters.

test_id.description: A test's name as the task spells it, the stem of its files.

name.description: An input or output name, as the primitive's declaration spells it.

input_id.description: A task input id, as task.yaml and submission.json spell it.

path.description: A path relative to the root of a checkout, with no empty, . or .. segment.

step.description: One container. Three shapes: runs once (inputs); one run for one test, an unfolded foreach (inputs and test, the pair of id and test unique in the plan); one container for many tests, a folded foreach (batch).

id.description: How later steps name this one. Unique in the plan, except that the runs of an unfolded foreach share it, one per test.

primitive.description: Which primitive this step runs, as name@version, for example compile@v1, for the log. The image below is what actually runs; the name is never resolved at grade time.

image.description: The primitive's image at that version, by digest, read from its declaration when the plan was compiled.

entrypoint.description: The program the container runs, as the declaration names it.

limits.description: The container's limits, all five, so the socket filter can refuse a container that carries less. For a batch step time_ms and cpu_ms are already for the whole batch; the other three are per item.

time_ms.description: Wall clock for the container. It is killed when it passes.

cpu_ms.description: CPU time any one process in the container may use.

memory_mb.description: Memory cap for the container, with no swap. Over the limit is a kill, not a slowdown.

pids.description: Process limit, what stops a fork bomb.

output_mb.description: How much one run may write: the largest file, and for a batch the total under out/ divided by the number of items.

inputs.description: The primitive's inputs, keyed by the names its declaration lists. Present for a step that runs once or for one test.

test.description: The test this run is for, one of the plan's tests. Present only on a run of an unfolded foreach.

batch.description: One item per test the container runs, in test order. A test that failed at an earlier step is left out when the harness runs the batch.

input_value.description: Exactly one of: a literal; a file or list of files in the publication checkout; a contestant input resolved through submission.json, or the language chosen for a code input; an output of an earlier step, for one test when that step runs per test. A reference to a per-test step without test gives that output over every test, in test order.

output_reference.description: An output of a step, by step id and output name.
